lines.text: The U.S. military built a bomb out of bats.

parts.tts: The U.S. military built a bomb out of bats.
parts.heard: The US military built a bomb out of bats.

lines.text: The plan: a million bats, each carrying a tiny timed firebomb.

parts.tts: The plan: a million bats, each carrying a tiny timed firebomb.
parts.heard: The plan, a million bats, each carrying a tiny-timed firebomb.

lines.text: Drop them over Japan. They'd roost in attics... and then ignite.

parts.tts: Drop them over Japan. They'd roost in attics...
parts.heard: drop them over Japan, they'd roost in attics.

lines.text: In May 1943, armed bats escaped during a test...

parts.tts: In May nineteen forty-three, armed bats escaped during a test...
parts.heard: In May 1943, armed bats escaped during a test.

lines.text: and set their own air base on fire.

parts.tts: and set their own air base on fire.
parts.heard: and set their own air base on fire.

lines.text: About two years. About 2 million dollars.

parts.tts: About two years. About two million dollars.
parts.heard: about two years, about two million dollars.

lines.text: It was canceled in 1944. The atomic bomb project took priority.

parts.tts: It was canceled in nineteen forty-four. The atomic bomb project took priority.
parts.heard: It was cancelled in 1944. The atomic bomb project took priority.

lines.text: The bat bomb was never used in combat.

parts.tts: The bat bomb was never used in combat.
parts.heard: The bat bomb was never used in combat.
